title: DNA Extraction from Sterivex Filters
author: Colleen Kellogg

steps.title: Lysozyme and RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL lysozyme (125 mg dissolved in 1000 µL 1× TE) and 20 µL RNase A (10 µg mL⁻¹, prepared as 1 µL in 999 µL 1× TE) to each Sterivex filter, reseal with Parafilm or a luer cap, place the filter in a labeled 50 mL Falcon tube and incubate in a rotating incubator at 37 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Proteinase K and SDS digestion
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Proteinase K and 100 µL 20 % SDS to each filter, reseal with Parafilm or a luer cap, keep the same labeled 50 mL Falcon tube, and incubate in a rotating incubator at 55 °C for 1–2 h.

steps.title: Lysate collection and sucrose rinse
steps.instruction: Using a new 10 mL syringe for each sample, remove the lysate from the Sterivex into a labeled 15 mL Falcon tube (do not pull up on the plunger while attached; if needed, unscrew, pull back the plunger, re‑attach and push to expel liquid, repeating until nearly all liquid and foam are removed). Add 1 mL sucrose lysis buffer (SLB), rotate the filter by hand several times to rinse, then plunge out the rinse liquid as before and pool it with the lysate in the 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Phenol:Chloroform:IAA extraction
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, add an equal volume (~3 mL) of Phenol:Chloroform:IAA (25:24:1, pH 8.0) to the lysate tube, invert by hand for 10 s, spin at 2500 g for 6 min (or until the aqueous layer is clear), wait ≥10 min before opening the centrifuge, and transfer the aqueous (top) layer to a new 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Chloroform:IAA wash and transfer to Amicon
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (~3 mL) of Chloroform:IAA (24:1) to the tube containing the aqueous layer, invert by hand for 10 s, spin at 2500 g for 6 min until the aqueous layer is clear and debris‑free, wait ≥10 min before opening, then transfer the aqueous layer into a labeled Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter tube (UFC801096, EMD Millipore).

steps.title: Amicon concentration and TE washes
steps.instruction: Perform the following sequence on the Amicon tube:

substeps.instruction: Top up with 1–2 mL 1× TE buffer, spin at 3500 g for 10–15 min; if >1 mL remains, add 2 mL 1× TE and spin again.
Add 2 mL 1× TE, spin at 3500 g for 6 min, discard filtrate.
Repeat the previous 2 mL TE wash two more times (total three washes). For the final wash, spin until 200–500 µL remain (typically 8–10 min).

Note the final volume, transfer the concentrate to a labeled 1.5 µL (should be µL) Eppendorf tube, rinse the Amicon sides with 50 µL 1× TE, and pool this rinse with the sample in the same labeled 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Final DNA elution and storage
steps.instruction: If desired, aliquot 50 µL of the final DNA solution into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube as a working stock and store at –20 °C; place the remaining DNA stock in a –80 °C freezer for long‑term storage.

steps.title: DNA quantification with Qubit
steps.instruction: Quantify the DNA stock using a Qubit fluorometer according to the manufacturer’s instructions, using 2 µL of the DNA stock for each measurement.

steps.title: Prepare normalized 2.5 ng/µL stock
steps.instruction: Calculate the volumes needed to make a 2.5 ng µL⁻¹ DNA stock for PCR (use the spreadsheet provided): determine the µL of DNA stock required for a 25 µL final volume at 2.5 ng µL⁻¹ based on the Qubit concentration, calculate the complementary volume of water, mix, and store the 2.5 ng µL⁻¹ stock at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare extraction negative and thaw filters
steps.instruction: If applicable, thaw filters on ice and replace Parafilm as needed. For a negative control, add 1800 µL filter‑sterilized, UV‑treated SLB into a new Sterivex, seal the bottom with Parafilm and the top with a cap or Parafilm, and process it identically to the samples.
